name: zan-workflows
description: TAPD Bug repair and requirement development with conversation review, confirmed Wiki Plans and independent execution.

interface.shortDescription: 需求与 Bug 共用执行计划，支持立即或手动开工，按已确认上下文自动合并、提测和构建。
interface.longDescription: Story development and Bug repair first collect project scopes, dependencies, implementation steps and tests. Return the review in chat or save the confirmed TAPD Plan. Execute it immediately on combined confirmation or manually in a new session. Reuse the same approved Git, test submission and Jenkins scope.
defaultPrompt: Scope Mock review using references/mock-development.md#清查范围: inspect the full current delivery diff and its affected runtime/import/activation/build boundaries at pinned revisions. Inventory-only historical modules are context, not automatically active blockers. Unchanged unrelated history does not require cleanup or another confirmation. Changes that introduce, modify, re-enable or newly ship an existing Mock remain blocking. Bind reviewed non-runtime inventory metadata separately from runtime module paths.

For requirement development and Bug repair, share missing item/branch facts with read-only collect, treat any selected existing Task as read-only scope evidence and batch stable local checks. Use workflow-session submit for one reviewed repository under matching authorization. A Bug publishes or reuses its one reviewed record only after Git/build/Wiki gates and before registration. Follow submitting-for-test/references/continuous-submission.md.

Keep Mock out of business logic: pages, components, business hooks/stores and rules do not import fixtures/handlers or carry Mock flags/parameters. Use the existing stable data-access interface and one configuration/assembly boundary per applicable feature. Keep Mock data, minimal state, handlers and startup bindings independently removable; exit replaces the data source and removes those files/configuration without rewriting business callers or flows. Apply the source/artifact exit gates as before.

Mock implementation follows references/mock-development.md: distinguish connected Query/Query Contract Mock, Query-only and non-Query projects, reuse the actual existing data path, and never equate an installed dependency with a working Mock binding. Default to normal business data only; simulated exceptions require explicit user, requirement or approved acceptance evidence. Keep fixtures, handlers, activation, data selection and reset in the data/configuration layer. Do not add product-page Mock markers, banners, debug panels, scenario selectors, reset controls or Mock branch suffixes by default. Retain product validation/error handling and real-call isolation; neither requires building an unrequested failure-scenario catalog. Plan/review and delivery records still disclose actual Mock scope.

面向中文用户时，按 references/execution-checklist.md#限制与确认说明，用完整中文解释限制、上线门禁、确认要求、阻塞原因和清理约束，包括引用规则及脚本返回的英文原因。说明实际触发条件、受影响操作、缺少的证据或授权，以及恢复执行所需条件；只展示本轮适用的限制。解释本次确认来自哪个技能时，链接出处并引用该技能的中文确认条款，不照抄英文句子；用户未明确要求核对英文原文时，不附英文规则引文。机器字段、枚举、代码、命令、路径和链接保持原样，状态码须配中文含义。中文说明不改变规则含义、操作范围或确认复用，也不新增确认节点。

Route $developing-requirement and $fixing-bug to $collecting-requirements. Use TAPD_PLAN by default, or SESSION for chat-only review. Confirm the exact Wiki Plan before saving and linking it on its Story or Bug, then stop by default for manual execution. A combined confirmation to save and execute immediately starts the same verified plan in this session. Route an explicit request to execute a saved Plan to $executing-tapd-plan, including in a fresh session with just its Wiki URL. A bare URL is read-only. Use $submitting-for-test for 直接提测 of already reviewed work. Projects, modules and steps are sections of the same item, without project Plan files or TAPD Task writes.

Use references/execution-checklist.md for standalone delivery: match the current execution request and established branch, environment, selected build and test Wiki to the concrete operations. Verify internally, reuse the implementation review, execute covered operations in the same turn and report receipts. Ordinary submission adds no independent review or repeat test suite. Read existing Task IDs only for a selected scope. Reuse completed effects and reopen only material changes.

For an immediately or manually started confirmed TAPD Plan and approved legacy execution checklists, reuse human approval of the complete execution checklist across downstream skills after exact scope/derivation checks. Do not request a second submission/build/Wiki approval for covered operations or technical PLAN states. A standalone test submission follows the same rule when its request and context cover the operations. Preview-only requests remain read-only. Include scoped automatic A-to-C-to-B conflict resolution in the first checklist; validate and review it before continuing, with no unapproved cleanup. Only material scope/operation changes or genuinely missing user decisions need further input. End the main workflow with actual execution results and next-step advice, not routine continue/cleanup questions.

Use the original fixed branch for continued work. Bug implementation verifies repair ownership and prepares one reviewed repair-record draft without stage comments. For test delivery, complete Git and selected build gates, verify the Wiki and its separate link comment when applicable, then publish/reuse and read back the single final repair record before TAPD registration. IMPLEMENT publishes it only at final implementation exit. Same-round rework updates the draft, not comments. Ordinary full Bug repair first enters 修复中, then reaches 待测试 only after those gates pass. Show the final TAPD target under 合并与测试环境, distinguish planned targets from actual readbacks, and preserve idempotent continuation. In the Task-based requirement workflow, implementation covers only selected Tasks and their acceptance.

Complete relevant verification and independent final review before authorized test delivery. Confirm delivery options in the current startup conversation. Execution Wikis record implementation and actual receipts. The legacy requirement checklist defaults to 直接提测：是. Explicit implementation-only requests, 先完成代码，我检查后再提测, 先不要提交/推送 or 暂不直接提测 show 直接提测：否 and stop at REVIEWED without delivery writes. Later direct submission refreshes existing diff/refs and invalidated verification/independent review, matches its exact internal checklist to the current execution instruction and continues through the authorized delivery. 直接提测 does not imply SKIP; only an explicit no-build choice disables Jenkins. Business scope restrictions such as 只开发 B 端相关功能, 仅改前端 or 只做所选 Task preserve the delivery choice confirmed for this run; only a delivery endpoint restriction such as 仅开发验证 or 不提测 disables it. Merge/build means the verified dev/develop target and project test environment, subject to the exact delivery plan. Test submission uses completionMode=TRIGGER_ACCEPTED and proceeds on the exact BUILD_SUBMITTED queue receipt without waiting; report build submitted, never deployment or publication success; go-live requires an explicit request.
Use submitting-for-test and going-live only for the requested delivery stage. Their exact write plans, readbacks, manual-merge handoff and separately confirmed cleanup remain authoritative.
Jenkins 提测结果显示“构建任务已提交”，面向用户的测试构建链接使用回执中已核实的 jobUrl；queueId/queueUrl 仅作内部触发接受证据。修正展示链接时复用原回执，不重新触发构建，也不增加队列、构建或日志查询；buildUrl 仅在真实读回本次构建后补充，不预造链接或声称部署、发包成功。

Separate business decisions in 需求待确认 from 外部数据与依赖 (contract/transport fields/credential configuration/environment facts) and internal implementation evidence. Follow references/external-data-dependencies.md and references/mock-development.md. Preserve the current execution Wiki or already approved legacy plan and original item/branch; dependency completion alone does not reset business approval. Scope readiness to approved current steps/stage, retaining future blockers. Every Mock has stable MOCK-* and MOCK_ONLY identity, actual paths, scenarios, real-call boundary and exit evidence. Mock is local-only by default. Ordinary development/direct submission/default deployment does not authorize Mock testing: display exact inventory, source contents, test target/environment, purpose and operations and obtain real human confirmation before the first selected delivery write. Reuse only matching explicit authority. Run scripts/mock-safety.mjs at delivery boundaries, including standalone helpers and daily builds. Production/default-branch delivery forbids active production-scope Mock and requires verified source exit/build exclusion plus version-bound project scripts that check source before triggering and actual final artifacts before publishing, with failure stopping publication; disabled switches, retired labels or query-contract release-check alone are insufficient. Use scripts/project-mock-gate.mjs and the self-contained assets/project-mock-check template. Verify real release-entry integration from pinned project/Jenkinsfile source and exact build receipts; Jenkins XML access and a fixed Pipeline syntax are not prerequisites. Missing actual project checks still block production. The confirmed TAPD Plan preserves external dependencies and Mock inventory; legacy missing review stays unverified.

Jenkins build parameters are maintained separately in project-knowledge/data/workspace/jenkins-build-contracts.json, with explicit sources/jenkins-build-policies.json profiles. Follow references/frozen-jenkins-parameters.md. Never query Jenkins parameter definitions, extract them from XML, or auto-refresh in deployment PLAN/EXECUTE. Use the frozen resolver to validate exact project/Job/profile, materialize all defaults, bind actual values and reject fixed environment/release-selector overrides. Missing/unavailable/ambiguous records block until the independent maintenance sync succeeds. Daily and full builds use run-jenkins-release.mjs with current local Job/profile/value hashes; source/Job/queue and production Mock checks remain separate.

For top-level workflows follow references/execution-feedback.md: after collection (SESSION stays in chat), start one local diagnostic runId on authorized save or execution, reuse it across stages and pass ZAN_WORKFLOWS_RUN_ID to workflow-session. Record observed stages, confirmation subjects, corrections and final outcomes; distinguish executor events from agent summaries and preserve coverage gaps/UNKNOWN. Diagnostics never store raw plans/results or authorize/replay writes, and recording failures do not stop work. Use report-execution only for a user-requested report/export. Upload only on explicit feedback submission to the hardcoded GitLab project http://git.jubaozan.cn/chenfangjie/skills (ID 374), freshly verified before each submission; do not ask for another upload confirmation when that exact request already authorizes it. Never auto-upload every run. Do not ask for destination setup or expose destination configuration, and never infer a different destination from the current business repository.
